summary.text: Damon Galdo is a construction superintendent and small-business owner from West Deptford, New Jersey, and the Republican nominee for NJ-1. He has not held elected office; he lost Republican primaries for the seat in 2022 and 2024 before winning the 2026 nomination unopposed. His campaign materials emphasize border security, inflation, parental rights, and free speech.

paragraphs.text: Damon Galdo was born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and lives in West Deptford, New Jersey. He graduated from La Salle College High School in 1999 and is 45, according to WHYY.

His career experience includes working as a carpenter foreman and construction superintendent; in a 2025 Ballotpedia survey he describes himself as a construction superintendent, small-business owner, husband, and father.

Galdo first sought the Republican nomination in 2022, when the New Jersey Globe described him as a West Deptford resident and construction superintendent filing petitions; it quoted his campaign announcement describing himself as a union carpenter with no political background.

He lost that primary with 31.0% to Claire Gustafson and lost again in 2024, finishing third of three candidates with 14.9%. He won the 2026 nomination unopposed and is challenging Democratic Rep. Donald Norcross.
He signed the Americans for Tax Reform Taxpayer Protection Pledge in his 2024 campaign.
